ambient_events: The whole south wall weeps, groundwater sheeting down it in a thin cold curtain.
Behind the running water something pale shifts, or seems to.
The drip here is constant enough that you stop hearing it, which feels like a mistake.
description: A long gallery where the water table has found the tunnel and never left. The south wall runs with groundwater year-round, slick and black and cold, and the floor is a shallow moving sheet. A cross-passage east ties back into the descending shaft; the way on drops south into deeper water.
name: Weeping Wall
